title: Maximum-sum submatrix

problem.name: Maximum-sum submatrix
problem.statement_latex: Given $A\in\mathbb Z^{n\times n}$ with word-sized entries, find $i\le j$ and $k\le\ell$ maximizing $\sum_{a=i}^j\sum_{b=k}^{\ell} A_{ab}$. Complexity counts RAM operations and coherent indexed access.
